unit.why: An anthology of teachings and quotations from earlier books on the 39 labours, Torah study (study plans, learning lishmah, musar reading) and the evil tongue. It has no real narrative: the brief legend of Mar bar Rav Ashi adjuring clouds and the Frankfurt rabbi's custom of reviewing tractates are only illustrations inside the teaching.
unit.boundary_note: The lashon hara section continues into the next division with the Zidichov rebbe's saying.
